card.name: Just before the word indication or indicated
card.fires_on: The word right before "indication" or "indicated", such as "when", "not", "clinically" or "another", and the start of the table header "Ind|ication". It predicts that a form of "indicate" comes next.

modes.label: Table header Indication
modes.description: The first piece of the column heading "Indication" at the start of a dosing table.
modes.example: Table 2 Prophylaxis Guidelines for Adults<< Ind>>ication Daily Dose (IV) Adults

modes.label: Word before indicated
modes.description: A small word or adverb right before "indicated" in phrases like "when indicated" or "as clinically indicated".
modes.example: including directed or random endometrial sampling<< when>> indicated, to rule out malignancy in

modes.label: Word before indication
modes.description: A modifier right before "indication" or "indicated" in the sense of approved use.
modes.example: taking montelukast sodium daily for<< another>> indication (including chronic asthma) should not

card.writes: It pushes the model to output forms of "indication", "indicated" and "indicate" next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "indication" or "indicated", as in "when indicated" or an Indication column.
